description: As the intent requester, award an intent to a winning bid. Marks the bid won and the others lost, closes the intent and creates the escrow. On a reviewed job the accepted review fee is paid now from your review credits (reviewFeeCents in the response); if they do not cover it the award is refused (402) and nothing is created. The response returns fundingSteps: sign each, in order, from your own wallet (USDC). Synmerco never holds your keys.
name: award_intent
